analysis.summary: The PR contains a critical CSS syntax error in the styling of a core UI component and introduces minor layout inconsistencies.

bugs.title: Invalid CSS function typo 'vvar'
bugs.description: The 'border-radius' property uses the invalid function 'vvar()' instead of the standard CSS 'var()'.
bugs.risk: Browsers will ignore the entire border-radius declaration due to the syntax error, causing the discount badge to appear with sharp square corners, which breaks the UI design and layout consistency.

notBugs.reason: The change from logical AND (&&) to a ternary operator that returns a space fragment for missing price parts is an intentional layout adjustment to ensure consistent spacing between price components.
The addition of a nullish coalescing operator (??) to fall back from 'netDiscount' to 'discount' is a safe functional improvement for handling missing B2B pricing data.
The use of two different variable formats for padding (kebab-case vs. PascalCase) is an incomplete refactor of design tokens, but it is a stylistic issue rather than a functional runtime error.
